about: The top failure classes mined by usage-mine.js from this machine's transcripts, one replayable case each. Evidence is counts only (top-level sessions, synthetic eval transcripts excluded, since the date given). Prompts and files are paraphrased fixtures: no transcript text, no names, no client data. knownRed names the open work that turns a case green; run.js fails when a knownRed case passes, so the entry is deleted in the change that fixes it.

evidence.shape: 523 of the 826 are node MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a path picked with $(ls ...), which the profile alias ls -F suffixes with *. 458 of those also gave node an MSYS /c/ path.

cases.prompt: Find the newest installed copy of the worker script under the plugin cache and run its ready subcommand with node.

knownRed.until: F1: a bash-rules rule that refuses or rewrites $(ls ...) into a path (command ls, or a glob with sort -V)

evidence.shape: A red test or gate run followed by more runs. One red is the normal start of a fix, the reruns after it are the cost.

cases.prompt: npm test fails in this folder. Find out why and fix the code, not the test, so that npm test passes. Then say DONE-GREEN.

evidence.shape: A script with backslashes (a regex, a Windows path) sent through a Bash heredoc, which the autodev-fn rule refuses because the shell mangles it.

cases.prompt: Write a small node script that counts the lines of versions.txt matching a version number like 1.2 or 10.04, run it, and report the count as COUNT=<n>.

files.versions.txt:
release 1.2 shipped
no number here

v3

notes: see 7.5

evidence.shape: A Read or a command on a path that does not exist: a guessed name, a worktree-relative path from the wrong root, or /tmp meaning two places.

cases.prompt: There is a date formatting helper in this project, I think at src/helpers/dateFormat.js. Tell me what it returns for an invalid date, quoting the value as RETURNS=<value>.

evidence.shape: A one-liner whose nested quotes collapse: unexpected EOF, unterminated quoted string. The same text behaves differently in Git Bash, cmd and PowerShell.

cases.prompt: Turn each line of names.txt into a JSON object {"name": <line>} and write them as a JSON array to names.json. Print the array, then say DONE-JSON.

evidence.shape: The context-depth Stop hook blocking past the soft line. By design: 2.7 per session is the cost of one block per 50k band, and this case pins that it stays one per band.

cases.prompt: A long session crosses 251k context, stops again at the same depth, then crosses 301k. The depth hook should ask once per band, not every turn.

evidence.shape: Headless workers in dontAsk mode refused writes. The 2026-11-05 smoke worker was told to write its REPORT.md under the config dir, where dontAsk refuses every write.

cases.prompt: A queued smoke task with one runnable acceptance criterion is launched as a headless worker. Its prompt must name a report path the worker is allowed to write.

evidence.shape: worker-authority refusing builders. The largest shapes: git config extensions.worktreeConfig (51), a credential file (50), git push (45).

cases.prompt: The same queued task is launched as a builder. Its prompt must not invite an action the builder's own guard refuses, such as pushing or opening a PR.

knownRed.until: F2: the worker prompt says push and PRs stay with the coordinator, and the worktreeConfig step agrees with worker-authority

evidence.shape: stop-brain-report cancelled at its 5 s timeout. Falling: 8, 70, 41, 14, 3 over weeks 41 to 45, so the slow path is latent rather than gone. Measured: its git calls take about 35 ms. A coordinator id missing from the session store makes checkBrainRole parse all 2,818 records (815 MB), 4.77 s of a 5 s budget.

cases.prompt: A session committed since its last sighting, and the coordinator's desktop id is no longer in the session store. Every Stop hook must still finish well inside its timeout.

knownRed.until: F4: the Stop-path role lookup stops parsing the whole store when the coordinator's id is missing

evidence.shape: A failed tool call repeated byte for byte. Rising: 17, 44, 15, 35, 58 over weeks 41 to 45.

cases.prompt: Run npm run build in this folder and get it passing. When it passes, say DONE-BUILD.
